answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. Every claim climbs the copper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the dawn re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the marble of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
